privacy.title: Privacy Policy

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.paragraph1: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data in accordance with
introduction.paragraph1Cont: relating to the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data.
introduction.paragraph2: By using our website and services, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by this Privacy Policy.

dataCollection.title: 2. Data We Collect
dataCollection.intro: We may collect the following types of personal information:
dataCollection.accountInfoDesc: Username, login credentials, and authentication data
dataCollection.technicalDataDesc: IP address, browser type, device information, and usage statistics
dataCollection.usageDataDesc: Information about how you interact with our platform and services

dataUsage.title: 3. Why We Use Your Data
dataUsage.intro: Your personal data is used for the following purposes:
dataUsage.purpose1: To create and manage your user account
dataUsage.purpose2: To provide you with access to our educational platform and services
dataUsage.purpose3: To communicate important information, updates, and notifications
dataUsage.purpose4: To improve our platform's functionality, user experience, and services
dataUsage.purpose5: To ensure the security and integrity of our platform
dataUsage.purpose6: To comply with legal obligations and regulatory requirements

dataProtection.title: 4. Data Protection
dataProtection.paragraph1: We are committed to protecting your personal data and maintaining your privacy. We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure the security and confidentiality of your information.
dataProtection.importantText: Your personal data is never sold, rented, or shared with third parties for marketing purposes without your explicit consent.

dataSharing.title: 5. Data Sharing
dataSharing.intro: We may share your personal data only in the following circumstances:
dataSharing.circumstance1: With trusted service providers who assist us in operating our platform (under strict confidentiality agreements)
dataSharing.circumstance2: When required by law, legal process, or governmental authorities
dataSharing.circumstance3: To protect our rights, property, or safety, or that of our users
dataSharing.circumstance4: In connection with a business transfer, merger, or acquisition (with prior notice)

yourRights.title: 6. Your Rights (Law 09-08)
yourRights.introCont: you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
yourRights.rightAccessDesc: You can request access to your personal data that we hold
yourRights.rightRectificationDesc: You can request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
yourRights.rightOppositionDesc: You can object to the processing of your personal data
yourRights.rightDeletionDesc: You can request deletion of your personal data under certain circumstances
yourRights.contactTitle: To exercise your rights, please contact us at:

policyChanges.title: 7. Policy Changes
policyChanges.paragraph1: We reserve the right to update or modify this Privacy Policy at any time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, legal requirements, or other factors. Any changes will be published on this page with an updated "Last updated" date.
policyChanges.paragraph2: We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically to stay informed about how we protect your information.

privacy.footer: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us using the information provided above.
